description: Seven complete motion formats, each with a beat structure in seconds, a shot list and presets: a found-footage analog-horror trailer of a website, an authentic VHS bouncing-logo screensaver, a pixel-art runner on a CRT, a wordmark with a wave running through it, a one-shot music video that follows a DAW timeline, a launch trailer for an import feature, and a kinetic lyric video. Values come from VHS signal models (ntsc-rs, Finn McKenty), pixel-art conventions (Pedro Medeiros, Slynyrd), School of Motion, Netflix timing rules, screenlife rules and launch-film designers on X. Use when someone asks for one of these formats, a VHS or analog-horror look, a pixel art animation, a lyric video or a beat-synced launch video. NOT for generating the song or footage (varg-ai, varg-music-video).
